Respect My Eyes

Settings are saved automatically and applied to open tabs immediately. If a page does not change, reload it.

General

Never run on these sites (one per line, e.g. example.com, also covers subdomains and embedded frames):

Fonts

Monospace

Font size px
Scaling %

Scaling applies to monospace fonts that sites name explicitly (e.g. Consolas) so they are not rendered larger than the browser's own monospace.

Extra fonts

Fonts that cannot be recognised automatically (typically a font stack without any sans-serif / serif / monospace fallback, or CSS loaded from another domain). Enter the font name as the website calls it and pick what it should be replaced with. Choose Never touch for icon fonts that get broken.

Add many at once

One per line as Name | sans, Name | serif, Name | mono or Name | ignore. The original format (Name|SANS-SERIF, Name|MONOSPACE) is accepted too.

Icon fonts
